I've written the review to `review.md` in the task folder, with the verdict `pass` and five notes, none of which must change. I only read the diff and `requirements.md`; I didn't open the modules' code or check any links.

- **Requirements:** the batch covers the 12 modules and each doc is under 80 lines with no dates. Each readme got a "More" line.
- **Linking gap:** `ui/badge`, `ui/panel` and `ui/toolbar` have no `doc/files.jsonl` entry, though the other nine do. Their readme link still makes the docs reachable.
- **Gaps recorded in the docs:** `ext/toc` ends with an "ASCII only" rule that its own warning says is false today. `ext/System` notes that `heal_limit` is never read.
- **Wording:** `ext/System` has an "owner's rule" line that earlier batches dropped.
- **Unchecked links:** `ui/panel` links to `/framework/ui/doc/record.md` and `/framework/ui/doc/decisions.md`, which the diff doesn't show.
